Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
We are currently hiring an Operations Shift Manager to reinforce and support our Operations teams.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), 
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your job:
Reporting to the Operations Manager, you lead assembly, disassembly, and inspection teams within a high-performance aerospace environment. You ensure daily workshop operations run safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with customer, aviation, and Safran standards. Your focus is on delivering engine shop visit milestones on time while maintaining the highest levels of quality and safety.

Main tasks and responsibilities:
Operations & Planning

• Translate weekly production plans into daily priorities
• Manage shop floor activities to achieve on-time delivery
• Allocate workforce and resources efficiently
• Ensure smooth shift handovers
• Coordinate with planning and support teams
Team Leadership

• Lead and coach Team Leaders, Mechanics and Inspectors
• Drive training and performance improvement
• Support recruitment and development
• Foster teamwork and accountability
Safety & Quality

• Ensure compliance with HSE standards
• Promote a strong safety culture
• Ensure adherence to aviation quality standards
• Participate in audits and corrective actions
Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Monitor performance using QRQC
• Identify and implement improvements
• Manage quality deviations
• Optimize processes and operations

Your profile:

• You are both a leader and a team player, able to inspire while collaborating with others.
• You bring expertise, holding a Bachelor or Master in Electromechanics with 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial environment.
• You have proven strong people management skills and the drive to take on new challenges with confidence.
• You are analytical and resilient, thriving under pressure and keeping a sharp focus on deadlines.
• You are communicative and fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are flexible, ready to work in shifts (Monday to Friday: 6am-2pm, 2pm-10pm).

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.description:
We currently have an opportunity for an HSE and Prevention Manager

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:
The HSE and Prevention Manager is responsible for defining, implementing, monitoring, and continuously improving the company's HSE strategy in accordance with Belgian legislation and Safran Group SSE standards. The role acts as the legally designated Prevention Advisor and leads the HSE team.
In order to ensure a safe, compliant, and sustainable working environment you will:

• Manage the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of health, safety, environmental, and prevention programs.
• Act as Prevention Advisor under Belgian legislation.
• Develop and deploy HSE strategy, policies and procedures.
• Conduct risk assessments and maintain prevention plans.
• Lead HSE training, awareness and culture initiatives.
• Conduct audits, inspections and compliance monitoring.
• Investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.
• Manage emergency preparedness, first aid and fire prevention.
• Participate in CPPT/CPBW and advise management.
• Ensure environmental compliance and sustainability initiatives.
• Lead and develop the HSE team.

Your profile:

• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You hold a Master's degree in Engineering or Safety & Health, or a related technical or scientific field.
• You are a Certified Prevention Advisor (Level 1) or Safety Coordinator.
• You have a strong interest in improving workplace safety and wellbeing with a preventive mindset.
• You have experience or strong exposure to manufacturing or supply chain environments, with a solid understanding of workshop activities and safety challenges.
• You have strong planning and coordination skills, and you have a practical and problem‑solving mindset.
• You have experience in developing and implementing training programs, and in evaluating the effectiveness of HSE processes, programs, and procedures.
• You are familiar with risk assessments and safety audits.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or a valid work and residence permit). Please note that visa sponsorship is not available.

This Belgian manufacturer of dry powder mixtures for the construction industry (mortars, adhesives, plasters, etc.), located in the Port of Antwerp, is looking to strengthen its current team with a motivated OPERATOR.

As an OPERATOR, you will be responsible for all operational tasks required during your shift for production and loading activities. You will play a crucial role in the production process and will be widely deployable across various production lines, from mixing processes to bagging.

Your responsibilities as an OPERATOR* will include:

• Monitoring and operating mixing and filling machines, such as dissolvers, mixing tanks and filling equipment.
• Operating, converting and setting up bagging machines.
• Setting up and loading packaging materials (e.g. film) onto the machines.
• Carrying out process checks and visual inspections of the finished product, such as checking viscosity and colour consistency.
• Replacing simple mechanical components on the production lines.
• Processing residual product and cleaning the factory, including cleaning mixing equipment and pipelines.
• Assisting drivers during loading operations.
• Carrying out internal transport and logistical activities using a forklift and/or reach truck.

REF:MEC1

Experience & Profile

• Experience with mixing, dispersing or filling liquids, or operating bagging and packaging machines, is preferred.
• A valid forklift and/or reach truck certificate is a major advantage.

• You have a technical aptitude and a strong problem-solving mindset.
• You are communicative and have a good command of Dutch or English
